purpose: Teach: 聴け/ダラダラ/働け/蹴っ/滑らか/呑み/噛ん/食費

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お話、もうちょっと、聴けば、寝る!
lines.en: Mom, just a little more story, then I'll sleep, I promise.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest negotiation. Soft but firm. He's not asking—he's proposing a deal. Small breathy pause after 'Mom', then the request tumbles out in one hopeful rush.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お休みの日、ダラダラするのも、いい時間ね。
lines.en: Mm-hmm. Days off—doing nothing is good time too.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, warm and present. A soft hum of 'mm-hmm' opens the thought. Slow, deliberate pace. She's not rushing him. The tone says: I understand what matters right now.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、今日、たくさん働けば、嬉しいね、明日。
lines.en: Dad worked really hard today, so he'll be happy tomorrow, right?
lines.style: Wondering aloud, connecting cause and effect the way a six-year-old does. Slightly uncertain, like he's checking if he understood correctly. Soft, thoughtful rhythm.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お友達、サッカーボール、力強く蹴っちゃダメよ、家のは。
lines.en: Your friend's soccer ball—don't kick it hard like that. Not the one at home.
lines.style: Gentle correction, not sharp. A small weight on 'hard.' She's not angry, just reminding him of a boundary he tested. Steady, matter-of-fact tone underneath the kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お餅、滑らかな食感、好き。
lines.en: I like how mochi feels smooth when you chew it.
lines.style: Genuine discovery in his voice. He's noticing a small sensory thing and sharing it because it matters to him right now. Soft, almost meditative. No performance.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、出張先で、軽く呑みに行ったみたい。
lines.en: Sounds like Dad went out for drinks while he was away on the trip.
lines.style: Light, accepting observation. Not judgment—just noting what happened. Slight warmth underneath, the way you mention something ordinary about someone you know well and trust.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お弁当、よく噛んで食べる、忘れないでね、と先生に言われた。
lines.en: My teacher told me to remember to chew my lunch really well.
lines.style: Reporting something important he was told. Earnest and literal—he's delivering information, not complaining. Small pause before 'really well,' showing he's emphasizing what the teacher emphasized.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 食費、家計、上手にやりくりするわよ。
lines.en: We'll manage the food budget carefully for the household.
lines.style: Quiet determination, spoken more to herself than to him. A hint of the weight she carries, but wrapped in quiet competence. Steady resolve, no complaint. Almost a promise she's making to keep things running.
